conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate (several light routes, Section 5 anchor): weak refatter Glyceryl Oleate@7, Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein@10, Panthenol@12, cationic Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride@15, Glycerin@18, pearlizer PEG-3 Distearate@9. None is prominent (all after Parfum@6), so C2 is not met and high is excluded. Counter-signal: every route sits after the fragrance and the guar after two preservatives, so the care is plausibly thin; low is the realistic neighbor.

weightPotential.whyThisBand: All depositing routes are late and light: weak refatter Glyceryl Oleate@7, hydrolyzed wheat protein@10, guar@15 after two preservatives, Hydrogenated Palm Glycerides Citrate@25; no silicone, payload_lipid or film former; buffered SLES chassis gives moderate reset.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate (W2): each family is late/trace in the list (all after Parfum@6; guar@15 after Sodium Benzoate@11 and Potassium Sorbate@14; protein@10 is a hydrolyzed, light film; the refatters are weak_refatter only), and a moderate SLES/betaine reset faces only light routes.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: W2 boundary with three light families; realistic unknowns could move it to moderate.
weightPotential.rationale: Low (6.6): converging families are all late and light against moderate reset; W2 reason recorded; no W-RICH (no payload_lipid).
